item.title: Ask HN: What physical publication do you still buy?
item.summary: I remember as a kid loving to read National Geographic and Club Nintendo in Bolivia. I want to subscribe to a PHYSICAL publication, to get news or entertainment it's fine. But something physical. I want to slow it down and have it be my little morning ritual. Like my dad used to read the newspaper.
